# ANALYSIS: VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_2DTE_Walkforward_Degradation

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  

## Summary of walk-forward degradation

The VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_2DTE candidate (HOLD) shows a walk-forward ratio of 0.556 (<0.70 threshold), degrading from 0.67 in the first half to 0.44 in the second half. Quarterly equity curves reveal two severely underperforming periods: 2025Q3 (−$40.89 vs 0DTE baseline) and 2026Q2 (−$29.11 vs 0DTE). These quarters coincide with low-volatility, choppy market regimes (VIX consistently <15 and range-bound price action). In contrast, the candidate’s +56% OOS expectancy is concentrated in 2025-Q4 and 2026-Q1 (higher volatility regimes). The 2DTE random-null test fails to clear significance (p=0.0647) in the most recent four months (2026-03..06), further indicating the edge is not regime-robust and likely driven by volatility-dependent gamma/theta dynamics rather than a structural edge.

## Regime-specific hypothesis

The degradation appears regime-specific: the 2DTE override underperforms when volatility is low and intraday price action lacks clear directional persistence (chop), likely because the longer DTE increases time decay and reduces gamma scalping opportunities in low-vol environments, whereas the 0DTE version benefits from higher gamma and faster premium acceleration on short-term moves. When volatility elevates (VIX >20), the 2DTE override retains or improves edge due to reduced theta impact relative to expanded move potential.

## Proposed mitigation

Introduce a volatility regime filter that disables the 2DTE override when VIX is below a threshold (e.g., VIX < 17.5) or when the 5-day VIX slope is flat/falling, thereby restricting the override to elevated-volatility regimes where the longer DTE confers a theta advantage without excessive decay. This filter should be evaluated at entry time using the same VIX source as existing VIX gates.

## Next steps

- Perform a Stage-1 backtest of the VIX-filtered 2DTE override to quantify impact on OP-16 anchors and walk-forward metrics.
- If results show improved WF (>0.70) and reduced quarterly concentration, advance to OOS validation and real-fills checks.
